decisions.reason: The certified HVAC plate heat exchanger sits close to the core offer. Industry growth and hiring suggest the firm has slack, and nothing signals a shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of the resources.
The firm credits the marine box cooler with a major market share in water cooling systems, so it clearly meets the aspiration level and should be kept.
The marine cooling unit has its own web page and builds on established marine competence, so the firm is likely to keep carrying it while results develop, helped by available slack.
The compact oil cooler gets only a brief mention, which leaves its results more uncertain, but it extends the established offer at low cost and there is no evidence of a shortfall.
Finned tubes for air coolers are a core component that is presented prominently, and they tie into the firm's own production, so problemistic search is unlikely to target them.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes reflect the firm's in-house R&D and are highlighted on their own page, which supports keeping them under favourable industry conditions.
